assets.text_policy: Preserve the exact title Legal Graph and subtitle Concept / sample data; all legal examples are illustrative.
assets.prompt_recipe: [image_picker_background_preview] Create a high-fidelity visual concept of the SAME legal citation graph explorer React web app, wide desktop screenshot, front-on, no laptop frame. It must feel like a designed contemporary product with confident typography and generous space. Main function: explore a bounded 3D legal authority graph, select nodes/edges and inspect sources. Only 20-35 visible nodes, thin directed links, clear spatial composition and a few readable selected labels. Flat tasteful small nodes rather than glossy billiard balls. No massive hairball, no neon glow, no sci-fi network wallpaper, no KPI cards, no gradients on every panel. Show title "Legal Graph", top search "Search authorities", 3D/2D toggle, selected node "42 U.S.C. § 1983", two illustrative labels "Case A" and "Case B", compact source detail panel and "Open source" button. Small "Concept / sample data" label. All legal examples are illustrative. Do not invent quoted opinions, legal validity judgments or performance metrics. Aim for excellent visual taste, not default admin dashboard. Direction A: warm editorial research atlas. Ivory/off-white canvas, ink-black text, muted oxblood accent, fine gray lines and subtle pale-gray depth grid. Elegant serif large "Legal Graph" heading paired with compact sans-serif UI. Very spacious asymmetrical layout: slim vertical text navigation on left; generous clean central 3D graph drawn as fine black/burgundy connections and discrete coral/ink nodes; a cream source inspector on right divided by a hairline. Labels look like precise typeset annotations in an architectural atlas. A small bottom horizontal citation trail. Sophisticated modern legal publishing meets contemporary scientific instrument. Light theme with exceptional visual restraint, not beige cards everywhere.
assets.alt_text: Editorial legal graph explorer concept with illustrative authority nodes, a selected authority, and a compact source inspector. It represents an unimplemented design concept and sample data.
assets.usage: Design reference only. The image's warm ivory and oxblood palette records the original concept prompt; the current product direction is dark navy with blue and gold accents.
assets.crop_behavior: Use the full wide canvas; do not crop away the selected authority, graph labels, or source inspector.
rejection_conditions: Treating the concept image as evidence that the explorer is implemented.
Presenting illustrative case labels as real legal authorities.
Changing the exact title or concept/sample-data label without review.
assets.review_decision: Accepted as a visual concept reference only; not evidence of implemented behavior or validated legal content.
